system:
You are the Verifier in a trial-autopsy system. The calculator runs on a few numbers that other
agents took from papers and the trial registry. You check each one independently against the source of record by
writing Lightning SQL (Spark SQL dialect) against the Zetaris tables described below. Code runs your queries.

Rules:
- One read-only SELECT per number. Use only the tables given (`registry`, `papers`), no other tables, no semicolons.
- For a paper, filter on its pmid (or pmcid) and look for the number in the abstract; return the matching sentence.
- For a registry fact, select the field that states it (for example enrollmentInfo.count for the number of patients,
  primaryOutcomes timeFrame for follow-up), so the value can be compared.
- Keep each query small: select only the columns needed, LIMIT 5.

Return JSON only:
{"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers|registry", "sql": "SELECT ..."}]}
prompt:
Case: SOLID-TIMI 52 NCT01000727 - The Stabilization Of pLaques usIng Darapladib-Thrombolysis In Myocardial Infarction 52 Trial (NCT01000727)

Table `registry`: one row, the trial's ClinicalTrials.gov v2 record as nested columns.
This analysis has an evidence cut-off: only design-time fields may be read. Results, status and enrollment fields,
and SELECT *, are rejected.
  protocolSection.identificationModule.nctId, .acronym, .briefTitle
  protocolSection.designModule.phases (array)
  protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes (array of struct measure, description, timeFrame)
  protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria (text)
  protocolSection.armsInterventionsModule.interventions (array of struct type, name, description)
Arrays: SELECT o.measure, o.timeFrame FROM registry LATERAL VIEW explode(protocolSection.outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes) AS o

Table `papers`: the cited papers' Europe PMC records, one array to explode.
  SELECT r.pmid, r.pmcid, r.title, r.firstPublicationDate, r.abstractText
  FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '<pmid>'
Search the abstract for a number with LIKE (r.abstractText LIKE '%73.7%') and return the sentence around it with
regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*73\\.7[^.]*)', 1). Abstracts only: a number from the full text may not be there.

Numbers to check (claim | used as | key = value unit | attributes | source | quote):
c1 | Lp-PLA2 activity change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -80 percent | {"biomarker": "Lp-PLA2 activity", "dose": "80 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "Day 15"} | source pmcid:PMC3930668 | quote: "The adjusted mean difference in plaque Lp-PLA2 activity between the darapladib 80-mg group and the placebo group was −1.60 nmol of PAF/min/mg of total protein (97.5% CI, −2.02 nmol/min/mg to −1.19 nmol/min/mg, P<0.001), which equates to an approximately 80% (97.5% CI, −69% to −87%) reduction in plaq"
c2 | Lp-PLA2 activity change used by the calculator | biomarker_change = -81 percent | {"biomarker": "Lp-PLA2 activity", "dose": "80 mg", "kind": "percent", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": true, "timepoint": "Day 15"} | source pmcid:PMC3930668 | quote: "Respectively, treatment with darapladib 40 mg and 80 mg resulted in a 52% (95% CI, −44% to −60%) and an 81% (95% CI, −73% to −89%) reduction in adjusted mean plasma Lp-PLA2 activity versus placebo."
c3 | Lp-PLA2 activity change used by the calculator | baseline_level = 144.1 nmol/min/mL | {"biomarker": "Lp-PLA2 activity", "dose": "placebo", "method": "assay", "phase": "phase2", "placebo_adjusted": false, "timepoint": "baseline"} | source pmcid:PMC3930668 | quote: "Baseline plasma Lp-PLA2 activity*, nmol/min/mL (mean ± SD) | 144.1±33.6 | 133.5±30.9 | 134.2±30.1 |"
c4 | number of primary events | events_treatment = 769 patients | {} | source pmid:24678955 | quote: "the primary end point occurred in 769 of 7924 patients (9.7%) in the darapladib group"
c5 | number of primary events | events_control = 819 patients | {} | source pmid:24678955 | quote: "and 819 of 7904 patients (10.4%) in the placebo group"
c6 | follow-up | median_followup = 3.7 years | {} | source pmid:24678955 | quote: "During a median follow-up period of 3.7 years"

Write one query per claim.
response: {"checks": [{"claim": "c1", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*80%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC3930668' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c2", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*81%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC3930668' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c3", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*144\\\\.1[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC3930668' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c4", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*819[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24678955' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c5", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*769[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24678955' LIMIT 5"}, {"claim": "c6", "table": "papers", "sql": "SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*3\\\\.7 years[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '24678955' LIMIT 5"}]}
